title: console sidebar: ⌘B / Ctrl+B should do what the expand/collapse button does (ruled B), not toggle the temporary float
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv

Filing gate ① · Source: maintainer ruling · carrier for the follow-up of #36112 (closed by PR #36297, merged).

## What is ruled
Leehom ruled B 「B ⌘B 和按钮一样固定展开」 (Ruling-ref comment 7074574380 on #36112): ⌘B / Ctrl+B does exactly what a press on the sidebar's expand/collapse button does. It collapses when expanded and docks when collapsed, and the state is remembered. The temporary float stays only on the window's left edge. This replaces "⌘B unchanged" in ruling 7069868269 and the shortcut half of "(and its shortcut)" in ruling 6973617688 on #35062; every other line of both stands.

## Done when
- ⌘B / Ctrl+B and the button share one action and one remembered state.
- The left-edge hover float is unchanged.
- The tooltip chord, comments, the checklist step and the pins that encoded the old ⌘B behaviour follow the ruling. Execution detail is in the decision record's Execution section (7074574380).
- ui surface, not governed; Clause-② no; Metadata-protocol none.

reach: every console user who uses the shortcut; read from the ruling.
Business reason: the shortcut and the button now do different things; the maintainer ruled they must match.
Reader: apps/console shell (sidebar).
Dedupe: `⌘B sidebar`, `Ctrl+B expand collapse` → only #36112 (closed) and #36227 (resizable sidebar, same files: order this card first).
Grade: p2.
